sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Malekin was a British folkloric spirit. This fairy was said to haunt a castle in Suffolk after she was stolen away from her family. The family had left her in the weeds while they worked in a nearby cornfield. Her story was recorded in the 13th century by Ralph of Coggeshall, an early collector of such tales.
